menu_active.functional_read: deliberate browsing and choosing, read from the face itself rather than from a surrounding glyph
menu_active.required_face_action: The exact V9 eye silhouette remains fixed, but the legal highlights form a clearly intentional off-center paired gaze that can later sweep through left, center and right stops. One brow lifts inquisitively while the other presses into a shallow focus angle; the mouth is a compact closed decision mark and cheeks stay quiet. The static target must look like the pet has paused on a choice, not like it heard a sound.
menu_active.choreography_intent: The later component plan proves browse by a deterministic highlight left-center-right scan with the brow focus landing after the scan. The target hold contains only the face-primary decision pose.
